title: F_5 packed type plus ops per R1 outcome
description:
Implement the F_5 packed type chosen by R1 (`6b3f6054`), with bitwise add / sub / mul / neg ops and proptest cross-checks against the scalar `Fp<5>` reference.

## Background

R1's decision doc (`dev/plans/r1_f5_encoding_decision.md`) names the winning F_5 encoding and documents the bitwise op count per op. The R1 design landed a bit-sliced D representation (per the prompt's hint). This issue lands the packed type at `gf2-algebra::packed::packed5` with the implementation directly transliterating the formulas from the R1 doc.

`unsafe` is not allowed here (`#![deny(unsafe_code)]`); the type uses pure Rust bitwise ops on `[u64; K]` for some `K` chosen by R1.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::packed::packed5::Packed5` exists, packs the lane-count chosen by R1 into the storage layout chosen by R1.
- [ ] [hard] `Packed5` implements `PackedField<Fp<5>>` per the D1b trait surface.
- [ ] [hard] `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` use the bitwise formulas from R1; the implementation is a direct transliteration.
- [ ] [hard] Proptest cross-checks all four ops against scalar `Fp<5>` per-lane on 1000 random pairs.
- [ ] [hard] `Packed5Vec` companion type exists for variable-length vectors with `mask_tail` invariant; word-boundary tests on len $\in$ {0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129}.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
